import React from "react" import { Button, ScrollShadow, Typography, cn } from "@heroui/react" import { BackLink } from "../BackLink" import { principleAttr } from "@/components/frames/_principles" import type { WithClassNames } from "@/modules/types/base/class-name" /** Identity chip shown after the back link ΓÇö an avatar (optional) + a name. */ export interface WorkSessionHeaderIdentity { /** Avatar image (e.g. an interviewer persona's face). Omit for a text-only identity (e.g. a course name). */ avatarSrc?: string /** Display name ΓÇö the interviewer's name, or the course/deck being worked. */ name: string } /** Props for {@link _WorkSessionHeader} ΓÇö presentational; every label already resolved. */ export interface WorkSessionHeaderProps extends WithClassNames { /** Label for the leading {@link BackLink} ("Leave interview" / "Exit"ΓÇª). */ backLabel: string /** Fired when the back link is pressed ΓÇö the caller owns the routing/confirm-modal. */ onBack: () => void /** * Optional bold label right after the back link, BEFORE the identity chip ΓÇö * disambiguates which WORK MODE this session is (e.g. "Quick Quiz" vs * "Flashcard Study") when a caller shares this shell across several modes with an * otherwise-identical header row. NEVER hidden on mobile (short, and more * essential for orientation than `identity`, which already hides at that * breakpoint). messages.message: `pages/LearningHistoryPage/` contains `CourseOutline/index.tsx` ΓÇö a screen folder holds its two halves ONLY (`component.tsx` = the shape, `index.tsx` = the wiring). Whatever this is, it has a real home: a component of its own goes to `blocks/<category>/`, a fetch goes to `hooks/`, a pure helper to `modules/utils/`, a shape to `modules/types/`, copy or a config map to `resources/`. "Only this screen uses it" is how a folder becomes a second codebase.
Import '@heroui/react' outside the vocabulary tier ΓÇö use the matching atom (vendor wrapped once); if missing, add an atom instead of importing vendor directly.
`AsyncContent` is retired ΓÇö thread `isSkeleton` to each leaf, and use AsyncContentEmpty/AsyncContentError from '@/components/composites/async/AsyncContent'.

JSX file without an `identity` prop on the root ΓÇö add `identity` with `tier` and `component` on the root frame/composite (see components/frames/_identity.ts); do not wrap with a hand-rolled data-tier div.
Prop `skeleton={<ΓÇª>}` is a hand-kept parallel skeleton tree that drifts from the real shape ΓÇö thread `isSkeleton` to each leaf so shimmer mirrors the loaded tree.
Sentence-tier file must not render raw `<div>`. Compose a typed vocabulary owner that owns this landmark, layout, or chrome (see `.claude/fe/contracts/sentence-hosts.md`).
`cn(...)` outside the vocabulary tier (BLOCK-5) ΓÇö treat this as a missing composite or missing variant; do not assemble classes here.
Do not pass `className` to house component `Skeleton`. Parent layout owns placement; use the parent principle or a named wrapper.
